description_en: Retrieves the list of gateway tuple tickets submitted by the user
description_zh: 获取用户已提交的网关元组工单列表
name: ListGatewayTupleOrders

parameters.help_en:
The list of ticket states used to filter results. If you do not specify this parameter, tickets in all states are queried. Valid values:

APPLYING: pending approval.

REJECTED: rejected.

ACCEPTING: being distributed.

ACCEPTED: distributed.

ACCEPTING_FAILED: distribution failed.

REVOKING: being revoked.

REVOKED: revoked.

REVOKING_FAILED: revocation failed
parameters.help_zh:
工单状态过滤列表，若不使用此参数，则表示查询所有状态的工单。可取值为：

APPLYING：申请中。

REJECTED：已拒绝。

ACCEPTING：分发中。

ACCEPTED：分发成功。

ACCEPTING_FAILED：分发失败。

REVOKING：撤回中。

REVOKED：撤回成功。

REVOKING_FAILED：撤回失败
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The start position of the query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of tickets to return in this query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的工单数量上限，需大于等于1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The field used to sort the query results. Valid values:

CREATED_MILLIS: sorts by ticket creation time.

ACCEPTED_MILLIS: sorts by ticket approval time
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果排序字段。可取值为：

CREATED_MILLIS：根据工单发起时间排序。

ACCEPTED_MILLIS：根据工单审批通过时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:
Used together with the SortingField parameter.

true: ascending order.

false: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
需配合SortingField参数一起使用。

true：表示升序。

false：表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_en: The list of gateway key ticket information returned by the query
List.description_zh: 查询到的网关密钥工单信息列表

AcceptedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was approved, in milliseconds
AcceptedMillis.description_zh: 工单审批通过的UNIX时间戳，单位为毫秒

CreatedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the ticket was submitted, in milliseconds
CreatedMillis.description_zh: 提交此工单的UNIX时间戳，单位为毫秒

OrderId.description_en: The order ID of the gateway key

OrderState.description_en: The application status of the gateway key

RequiredCount.description_en: The number of gateway keys issued

TupleType.description_en:
The gateway key type. Valid values:

singlechannel: low-speed edition (single-channel).

standard: Standard Edition.

hybrid: high-speed edition (Hybrid).

noncontractual: high-speed edition
TupleType.description_zh:
网关密钥类型。

singlechannel：低速版（单通道型）。

standard：标准版。

hybrid：高速版（Hybrid型）。

noncontractual：高速版

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tickets that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的工单总数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
